description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for followers in a Conduit application, including the command definition, validation, and request handler to remove a follower relationship.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a follower by username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command ensuring the Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a follower, verifying existence, removing the follow relationship, and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to locate the target user, verify the current user, remove the follow record if exists, and return the profile.
